title: Include a tool feedback entry in the pausedShow fixture used by TestRenderCLIViews so the brief's render command shows the new section

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-145742-cab5, project ork, item S389:

Include a tool feedback entry in the pausedShow fixture used by TestRenderCLIViews so the brief's render command shows the new section

Evidence: internal/cli/render_test.go:26 renders pausedShow(), which has no ToolFeedback; the section needed an overlay test to render
